meta.title: Financial-survey cohort findings — Pass 1, frozen 20 August 2026
meta.linkage: Pledge linkage is by exact email match only. It is a lower bound: a respondent who pledged under a different address is counted as having no linked pledge. The financial survey and pledge form both collected email from every respondent, so this pair is well observed.
meta.universe: Counts are exact-email identities on the financial survey, respondent-deduplicated. The pledge-linked group means identities linkable by exact email to a pledge submission, not a verified set of people who pledged.
meta.pledge_nature: Pledges were explicitly non-binding and no money was collected. A pledge is a commitment signal, not a payment.
meta.exclusions: Five reviewed test submissions registered across the four instruments are excluded from every count.
meta.reproduction: Every count was re-derived by an independent script from the flagged corpus and matched the analysis exactly.
meta.instruments_note: Denominators are instrument-specific and never mixed: financial survey /145, expression-of-interest /58, community survey /32.
